create_slide_from_layout: create a new PowerPoint slide from a layout file in an unpacked PPTX directory
duplicate_slide: duplicate an existing PowerPoint slide in an unpacked PPTX directory
add_to_content_types: register a new slide in the [Content_Types].xml of an unpacked PPTX package
add_to_presentation_rels: add a slide relationship entry to presentation.xml.rels in an unpacked PPTX package
get_next_slide_id: compute the next available slide ID from presentation.xml in an unpacked PPTX package
